claims.text: Over the 14 days from the patch, the positive share was -1.4 points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch (90% range -4.8 to +2.0). That isn't enough to credit the patch: its 90% range includes no change at all.
Negative reviews mentioning story and world dropped by 5.35 percentage points in the window compared to the baseline.

report.summary: Over the 14 days from the patch, the positive share was -1.4 points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch. Negative reviews mentioning story and world dropped by 5.35 percentage points in the window compared to the baseline. The patch and a price change or sale are inconclusive, while off-topic reviews or a review bomb, a change in who reviewed, and noise or seasonality are ruled out.
